title: Degree-one normalization on a pulled tautological generator chart
statement: Let $h:T\to S$ be a scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme], $E$ a quasi-coherent module [pqf-def-coherent], $D$ a normalized tautological quotient [def-per-projective-bundle-quotient-data], and $a:T\to P=\operatorname{Proj}_S\operatorname{Sym}(E)$ an $S$-morphism [def-trf-canonical-symmetric-graded-algebra, def-nagata-relative-proj]. Let $U\subset S$ and $W\subset T$ be affine opens with $W\subset h^{-1}U$, and suppose $a|_W$ factors as $k:W\to\operatorname{Spec}(A_{\iota(m)})_0\to P$ for $m\in E(U)$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. Let $l=a^*\iota(m)$ be the specified pulled tautological section [def-trf-line-quotient-chart-inverse-data]. Then $l$ is a free generator; the ring map $\kappa:(A_{\iota(m)})_0\to\mathcal O_T(W)$ of $k$ sends $r/1$ to $h^*r$; and the pulled quotient $q_a$ sends every $v\in E(U)$ to $\kappa(\iota(v)/\iota(m))l$. Fractions and quotient sections are those of [lem-trf-line-quotient-homogeneous-fraction-map]. No graded extension or all-degree coefficient identity is assumed.

source.place: Tags 01OA (section-projective-bundle) and 01O4 (lemma-apply-relative); local normalized tautological quotient calculation and arbitrary pullback.

proof.text: On the image O of the standard open D_+(iota(m)) under the relative chart j, restrict the normalized sections from the base chart. The section-normalized adjunction identifies their tensor pullback along j with the unitToTwist sections by D.generator. The proved absolute Proj lemmas isFreeGenerator_unitToTwist and map_unitToTwist_eq_smul give the free generator and the v/m relation. The section comparison with Mathlib pullback is the unit-compatible uniqueness isomorphism of adjoints. Tensor pullback along an open immersion is injective on sections over its range; bijectivity on sections and on structure rings descends the free-generator assertion. This gives the two assertions on O.

The factorization hk puts W inside a inverse image of O. Pull back the section relation along a and restrict to W. The normalized adjunction preserves scalar multiplication and restriction, and its unit-compatible comparison with Mathlib pullback preserves free generators. Its normalized composition comparison and naturality identify the image under pulledQuotient with pulledTautologicalGenerator. For the coefficient, use the standard chart isomorphism c:D_+(iota(m)) ≅ Spec(A_(iota(m))) and the section isomorphism j.appIso. Applying appLE to hk gives the factorization of the ring map; basicOpenToSpec_app_top cancels c and turns the pulled coefficient into the transported k.appTop map displayed in the statement.

Compose hk with the relative-Proj projection and use ha. The relative chart projection is toSpecOfAlgebra followed by the base affine isomorphism. The proved formula awayι_toSpecOfAlgebra identifies its composite with the spectrum map of r ↦ r/1. Cancel the base open inclusion and its affine isomorphism, then apply appTop and naturality of ΓSpecIso to obtain precisely the scalar identity. These are identities in arbitrary rings, including zero rings.
